definition: For any two first movers f and g, if InAct f r iff InAct g r for every supplied respect r, then essence f = essence g.
note: Open analyst condition with no content assignment. ConstitutiveContentComplete and FirstMoverContentAgreesWithAct together imply it, and the implication does not reverse (ContentBundleStrict). Given individuation, the suppositum/nature adapter and every-perfection it is equivalent to at-most-one first mover. Using InAct leaves the formal/eminent question of DISAMB-IN-ACT unchanged.
